site.description: AI stock research, portfolio analysis and disciplined investment workflows for modern investors.

home.headline: Unlock Your Investing Edge
home.description: Six specialist AI analysts research a stock, argue the bull case against the bear case, and hand you a verdict with entry, target and stop levels attached — for NSE listings and global markets alike.

features.title: AI Score
features.summary: A four-part signal engine that blends trend, valuation, sentiment and execution quality into one verdict for every stock you watch.

highlights.title: Signal stacking
highlights.detail: Each score combines valuation momentum, market context and sentiment to reduce noisy single-metric decisions.

highlights.title: Clear confidence
highlights.detail: The model marks how strong the conviction is before it ever tells you to act.

highlights.title: Fast context
highlights.detail: A single score makes it easy to compare companies, sectors and watchlists in seconds.

process: Collect valuation, trend, sentiment and operational quality inputs across the stock's relevant time window.
Normalize each signal into a common risk-adjusted score before comparing it with peers and benchmarks.
Blend the readings into a single verdict with a confidence band and an actionable next step.
impact: Helps investors avoid hype-driven entries without removing the conviction behind a good thesis.
Creates a repeatable discipline for comparing opportunities across sectors and benchmarks.
Turns a crowded stream of headlines into a structured decision framework.

features.title: The Swarm
features.summary: A specialist research team of AI agents argues the bull and bear cases side by side so you see the why behind the score.

highlights.title: Multi-angle review
highlights.detail: Fundamental, technical and risk lenses are evaluated together instead of in isolation.

highlights.title: Balanced debate
highlights.detail: The swarm surfaces the counterarguments you are most likely to miss in a one-sided narrative.

highlights.title: Evidence trail
highlights.detail: Each conclusion is traceable to the factors that moved the score and the price thesis.

process: Assign research tasks to specialist AI personas focused on fundamentals, charting, risk and market context.
Have the agents challenge each other with supporting evidence and trade-off analysis rather than static summaries.
Package the strongest aligned arguments into a decision-ready narrative with clear trade boundaries.
impact: Reduces blind spots created by one-dimensional analysis or a single expert bias.
Makes it easier to understand not just the recommendation, but the assumptions behind it.
Creates a stronger investable story when you need to defend or revisit a thesis.

features.title: Workspace
features.summary: An integrated investor workspace that keeps your watchlists, portfolios, thesis notes, and action trail in one place.

highlights.title: Portfolio memory
highlights.detail: Every position and note sits inside the same coherent map of your investing process.

highlights.title: Decision trail
highlights.detail: You keep the rationale, target, and review checkpoint connected to each action.

highlights.title: Execution clarity
highlights.detail: The dashboard condenses crowded information into a cleaner workflow for investors and analysts.

process: Bring each idea, portfolio holding and market watch into a single investor workspace.
Tag positions with thesis notes, risk categories and review checkpoints to maintain context over time.
Turn the workspace into a living decision ledger for portfolio updates, scenario checks and review cycles.
impact: Improves consistency across watchlists, position reviews and trade deliberation.
Makes it easier to revisit why a position was entered, changed or exited.
Keeps portfolio decision-making organized even as the number of ideas grows.

features.title: How it works
features.summary: A guided investment path that moves from idea discovery to thesis validation, portfolio management and disciplined review.

highlights.title: Discover signals
highlights.detail: The workflow begins with a clear market question and a scan of the strongest opportunities.

highlights.title: Challenge the thesis
highlights.detail: Counterarguments and risk scenarios are tested before you size the position or commit capital.

highlights.title: Track outcomes
highlights.detail: The process keeps learning from review cycles so the next decision is sharper than the last.

process: Start with a market question, a watchlist or a thesis that deserves validation.
Use the score and swarm insights to pressure-test assumptions, risk and timing before acting.
Review execution, portfolio impact and outcome data to refine the next cycle and stay disciplined.
impact: Creates a repeatable path from research to action without depending on ad hoc process notes.
Helps investors become more consistent and less reactive in volatile markets.
Brings a clear thread from idea generation to portfolio-level review and learning.
